items.title: createCustomerAddressesStep

items.title: maybeUnsetDefaultBillingAddressesStep
items.description:
This step unsets the `is_default_billing` property of existing customer addresses
if the `is_default_billing` property in the addresses in the input is set to `true`.

items.title: maybeUnsetDefaultShippingAddressesStep
items.description:
This step unsets the `is_default_billing` property of existing customer addresses
if the `is_default_billing` property in the addresses in the input is set to `true`.

items.title: updateCustomerAddressesStep
items.description: This step updates one or more customer addresses.

items.title: updateCustomersStep
items.description: This step updates one or more customers.

items.title: validateCustomerAccountCreation
items.description:
This step validates the input data for creating a customer account.
The step throws an error if:

- The email is missing
- A customer with the email already exists and has an account
- A guest customer with the email already exists
